answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 46013 Country: India Title: Innovation Question: My question is for festival "KUNDAE" which is spread in Islami society please give me reason it is in Islamic festival or not. Answer ID: 46013 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1030/680/L=1434) The custom of kunda is baseless and innovation (bid’ah) which is forbidden as per the Ahl Sunnah al Jamah. It is not an Islami festival and it should be avoided. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
